description: Sets the base resume every application is tailored from, from exactly one source. A new upload uses AI tokens; a saved document does not. A local file path is not a URL. The resume is saved unchanged. In ChatGPT, resume_file takes a resume file the user attached. It replaces the user's current base resume; the old one stays in their documents.

document_id.description: One of the user's saved resumes to make the base (an id from getmattered_get_account). Free. Either this, resume_text or resume_url.

resume_file.description: A resume file the user attached in ChatGPT, as the file itself rather than retyped text. Other clients use resume_text or resume_url. GetMattered reads it once: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: The user's resume text exactly as they gave it, word for word, with every date, employer, title and fact unchanged. Either this, resume_url or document_id.

resume_url.description: An https link to the resume file: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB. Either this, resume_text or document_id.

name: getmattered_set_resume

documentId.description: The resume now used as the base for every application.

onboardingCompleted.description: True when the account setup is finished, so GetMattered searches for this user.

parsed.description: False when the resume is still being read; call getmattered_get_account in a minute.

preferencesSeeded.description: True when empty job preferences were filled from this resume.

title: Set Resume
